title: Residency-aware evidence pipeline with flexible export formats and tenant scheduling
creator: Lena Park
description: Deliver a production-ready evidence export pipeline that produces PDF and CSV compliance artifacts per-tenant, enforces residency and retention policy at export time, and supports scheduled delivery to tenant destinations (S3 buckets, secure FTP, and vendor endpoints). The feature must: (1) respect per-tenant residency settings (region and residency scope), (2) apply retention filters and redaction rules before export, (3) watermark and cryptographically sign PDFs with an audit hash, (4) split large exports into chunked deliveries with manifest files, (5) support tenant time-zone aware scheduling and retry/backoff policies, and (6) surface export status and cost estimates in the console dashboard. This ticket covers the PM scope: product requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and early stakeholder reviews. Engineering grooming and design mocks will be linked in comments.
comments: 2026-03-02 Aisha: Kickoff w/ Eng and Security. Agreed to scope initial formats to PDF+CSV and a generic S3/FTP delivery adapter. Asked ENG to validate residency enforcement options (region tagging vs. tenant partitioning).

2026-03-04 Miguel Torres (ENG): Prototype shows we can enforce residency via routing exports to region-specific worker clusters; need to confirm egress and cross-region copy costs. Added ENG-8471 as dependency to add region-aware delivery hooks.

2026-03-06 Compliance review (Lena Park): Require PDF watermark containing tenant ID, export timestamp, and a SHA256 audit hash. Also requested retention cutoff logic be applied server-side before export generation.

2026-03-08 Design review (Maya Chen): Initial dashboard mockups for scheduled exports. We added per-tenant scheduling window UI and timezone selector; UX asks for per-export preview (first page CSV/PDF example) before scheduling.

2026-03-10 Aisha: Coordinated with Solutions to collect top-10 customer delivery destinations and compliance requirements. Adding optional encrypted delivery to support HSM-backed key rotation (future EPIC).
2026-03-12 ENG: Began work on export manifest schema and chunking strategy. Need to decide manifest signing approach (service key vs. tenant-supplied key).
acceptance_criteria: Administrators can create scheduled export jobs scoped to a tenant and choose PDF and/or CSV as output formats
Export pipeline enforces tenant residency: exports for tenants with region restrictions are generated and delivered from within the allowed region without cross-region storage copies
Retention filters (date ranges, event types) are applied server-side before any data is serialized for export
Generated PDFs include a visible watermark (tenant ID + timestamp) and an embedded SHA256 audit hash; PDF signing option available for enterprise tenants
Large exports are split into chunked files with a signed manifest; delivery adapters support ordered reassembly and resume on retry
Scheduled delivery supports tenant-local timezone windows and exponential backoff retries; failures produce alerts in the Console and a retry matrix in the export UI
Delivery destinations support S3 (with region bucket verification), secure FTP, and custom webhooks; configuration validates residency compatibility during setup
Console dashboard shows per-export cost estimate, size, status, and time-to-completion for active jobs
Security team has completed a review and signed off on watermarking, signing, and key-management approach
